propositions: Process-local lru_cache on _rendered() causes each xdist worker to independently render all 178 corpus bodies (~884 pandoc spawns per worker), duplicating work across workers instead of sharing the immutable artifact.
Three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical tests each recompute render_markdown_to_wiki(body) for pass 1, regenerating bit-for-bit identical values already cached in _rendered().

Replace process-local cache with session-scoped disk artifact keyed by SHA-256 digest of corpus JSON, wiki_render module source, and pandoc version, shared across xdist workers via tmp_path_factory.getbasetemp().parent.
Shard artifact per stratum (code_arrow/table/prose) and probe in PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER-rotated order to allow concurrent workers to fill different shards rather than queueing on the same corpus lock.

Use atomic os.mkdir for mutual exclusion with 150s deadline fallback so a blocked loser degrades to local rendering instead of deadlocking when the winner crashes, remaining under the 300s hang guard.
